text: Scaffold the project, benchmark harness, baseline workflow, and evaluation structure around three representative Django/DRF development cases. Prove broken repo -> issue report -> baseline agent -> patch -> evaluator -> metrics -> report. Keep the evaluator separate, pin dependencies, use synthetic data, and run locally with uv. Propose the file structure and design decisions before editing.

Proposed a src/regression_investigator harness, provider-neutral workflow adapter, benchmark/cases/dev inputs separated from evaluator tests and oracle, ignored results/trajectories, prompts, schemas, tests, and reproduction docs. Recommended a provider-neutral command adapter plus Docker-backed agent isolation, with subprocess mode explicitly development-only.

Approved the provider-neutral adapter and Docker-backed isolation. Required a stable invocation/output/exit/runtime/patch/trajectory contract, workspace-only agent visibility, network disabled by default, hard timeouts, evaluator execution after sandbox exit, preservation of the PDF, and ignored generated artifacts.

Committed to implement the isolated runner contract and harness, three broken Django/DRF case repositories and host evaluators, end-to-end tests, and a smoke run on feat/benchmark-scaffold without modifying the PDF.

summary: Created feat/benchmark-scaffold and inspected uv, Docker, Python, and the preserved PDF before implementation.

Added execution-mode propagation and smoke-agent assertions that evaluator paths and network were unavailable inside Docker.
Implemented trajectory parsing/error capture and evidence-chain metrics across models, runner, metrics, harness, reporting, schema, and tests.
Added integrity coverage proving hidden evaluators reject every broken input and smoke repairs do not qualify as evidence-backed.
Ran the frozen pytest suite after the initial implementation.
